preconditions.description: The number of houses N must be greater than 1 and at most 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= N and 1 <= b <= N and a != b for a, b in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two distinct houses within the valid range of house numbers.
There must be exactly N-1 roads connecting the houses.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the total length of the shortest paths and a valid assignment of new houses.

postconditions.expression: all(v_i != i for i, v_i in enumerate(assignment, start=1))
postconditions.description: Each villager must move to a different house than their original one.
The assignment must consist of N distinct house numbers.
